description: This file is a JavaScript module responsible for initializing syntax highlighting, rendering LaTeX equations with KaTeX, and rendering diagrams with Mermaid within a documentation or web page. It uses DOM manipulation and dynamic module imports to enhance code blocks, mathematical equations, and diagrams upon page load.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Executes a callback when the DOM is fully loaded.

methods.name: loadCSS
methods.description: Dynamically loads a CSS file into the document.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Dynamically loads a JavaScript file and executes a callback upon load.
